planning_notes: The request for 5 MEDIUM difficulty targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool. To ensure non-redundancy and high quality, each target was assigned a unique pedagogical facet: 1) Conceptual understanding of the VAE mechanism, 2) Theoretical rationale for the KL divergence term, 3) Code interpretation of the reparameterization trick, 4) Parameter change analysis regarding latent dimensions, and 5) Practical application to the Fashion-MNIST dataset. This covers the full spectrum from theory to implementation and application without repeating assessment angles.
